description: Generate a printable LPI pitch-test chart to measure or calibrate the actual lens pitch of a lenticular sheet. Use this tool when the user has a nominal LPI and wants to verify the real value, calibrate a new lens sheet, or determine the correct lens pitch before interlacing. The chart contains an LPI sweep with alignment marks, intended to be printed at 100% scale and evaluated with the physical lens sheet. The tool outputs an image plus measurement instructions. Scope: physical lens calibration only; it does not compute print dimensions, view counts, or prices.

lpi.description: Target (nominal) lens LPI, the center of the sweep, default 60

steps.description: LPI step between adjacent blocks, default 0.1

name: generate_pitch_test_chart
title: Generate a lenticular pitch test chart
